metadata.scenario: The office receives a call to provide a quote for a corporate event catering. Category: Quote Request. Outcome: quote_provided.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret, how can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is George Williams. I’m calling to get a quote for a corporate event catering. Hello, George! Just to clarify, we primarily provide home healthcare services. Are you looking for in-home care or event catering? Right, sorry about that. I meant to say I’m looking for a quote on some personal care assistance for my team. Got it! We offer personal care services. Could you tell me how many clients we would be assisting? We’d need assistance for about 10 people for a corporate retreat over the weekend. Okay, and what type of personal care assistance are you looking for? Just some basic help with hygiene, maybe some companionship, and light meals if possible. Great, we can provide Personal Care Assistance at $28 to $35 per hour. How many hours do you think would be reasonable for an event like this? Typically, for a full day, about 8 hours would be standard, depending on the needs of your team. So that would be around $280 to $2800 total for the day then? That’s correct. Would you like to schedule the caregivers for a specific day? Yes, we're looking at Saturday and Sunday next week. Perfect! I can help you with that. Do you have any specific requirements for the caregivers? Ideally, someone with experience in dementia care, as we have some team members needing extra support. I’ll make a note for that. Our caregivers specializing in dementia care can be matched accordingly. That would be perfect. Can you send me a confirmation email once it's scheduled? Absolutely. Can I get your email address for the confirmation? Sure, it’s george.williams@email.com. Thank you, George. I’ll follow up with the details and any special requests you've mentioned. I appreciate it! Is there anything else I should know? Just that we'll call you a day before to confirm the arrangements. Sounds good. Thank you for your help, Margaret! You're welcome, George! Have a great day, and we look forward to helping you! You too, bye. Bye!
